messages:
Emma Chen: FYI final MeridianBank POC readout tomorrow 10am PT. I uploaded a metrics draft, please scan and flag blockers.

Raj Patel: noted. procurement asked for 12mo committed pricing + burst OBO. can we confirm approach?

Ben Kline: i'll prepare a 12mo commit proposal. q: trial credit vs discount on commit? prefer credit against commit to drive conversion.

Luca Moretti: SE notes: median latency 92ms, p95 210ms, throughput 85 reqs/s on 4x A100 equiv. KV cache hit ~42%.

Luca Moretti: evals: 30 prompt cases, F1 0.78 target 0.82. primary issue - entity recall with long context.

Maria Gomez: security SQ mostly done. two outstanding items: KMS rotation cadence and short isolation statement for Dedicated (for SOC/legal). I'll draft both.

Raj Patel: who replies on SOC isolation text? legal/procurement pressing.

Maria Gomez: i'll own drafting the isolation note and loop compliance. ETA EOD.

Luca Moretti: quick mitigation: (1) targeted prompt canonicalization, (2) prefix KV caching for user tokens, (3) small reranker on top-5. Sim shows recall from 0.78 -> 0.81 with reranker.

Emma Chen: include reranker as near-term fix in readout and roadmap items for tuning.

Ben Kline: pricing plan: (A) 12mo commit with 20% off hosted list, (B) burst at list price with 5% overage cap first 3 months. i'll share spreadsheet.

Raj Patel: SLA ask is 99.9% for Dedicated. is that included or add-on?

Maria Gomez: SLA is an enterprise add-on. legal prefers explicit schedule + remedies. i'll note that in SQ packet.

Emma Chen: action items: Maria - SQ + isolation statement (EOD); Ben - pricing sheet (EOD); Luca - reranker sims + prompt template (by 3pm PT); Raj - confirm attendees and client KPIs.

Raj Patel: invite sent. attendees: MeridianBank POC lead, infra, procurement, Emma, Ben, Luca, Maria, me.

Luca Moretti: for slides include one failure example with input, model output, and reranker result. concrete before/after helps.

Emma Chen: if no flags by 2pm i'll post final deck. thanks all :raised_hands: 

Ben Kline: uploading pricing now.

Maria Gomez: linked draft SQ answers in calendar invite. ping for stronger language.

Raj Patel: aim to close procurement in readout and push for PoC->commit decision within 30 days.

Emma Chen: agreed. endthread.
